works.description: 從羊毛聯想到了網球，進而聯想到了網球籃。因此決定採用裝滿網球的籃子作為設計靈感，將其轉化為一種既富有趣味又實用的家具形式。
works.longDescription:
使用羊毛氈的手法來實現造型概念，羊毛為主體材質，透過混色使整體色彩更加豐富而不死板，使用扎製的手法，不借助任何縫線或沾黏，配合網狀的結構，融合多種造型語彙，包括球體、條狀結構與鐵網。

此系列包含三張高低不一的凳子，整體框架以倒U型為主要結構，底部稍微擴大，既增添了穩定性，也作為造型語言的一部分。
works.english: Wool reminds me of tennis, which in turn reminds me of tennis baskets. By using a basket full of tennis balls as a design inspiration and transforming it into a piece of furniture that is both playful and practical.
works.english_detail:
The wool felt technique employs color mixing to enhance richness and flexibility. Using a tying method without stitches, various forms like spheres and strip structures are created.

 This series features three stools of varying heights with an inverted U-shaped frame that adds stability and design appeal.

title.sub: 吊燈組 / 磁吸壁燈組
title.sub_en: Pendant Light Set / Magnetic Wall Lamp Set

works.description:
Ⅰ.曲線從U延伸至W，前後扭曲，羊毛球點綴，製成吊燈，提供兩種配色選擇。

Ⅱ.各色小燈組，底部磁吸設計，羊毛球為開關，可吸於金屬牆面作壁燈。
works.longDescription:
從U形曲線拉伸為W形，並透過前後錯落的扭曲方式增添層次感。提供兩種配色選擇，以適應不同環境與氛圍。

懸吊處以對比色細線纏繞，電線隱藏於管狀結構內，直連天花板，保持美觀簡潔。網格元素與鏤空中心強調視覺焦點，跳色對比增添層次感，整體造型既有趣又俏皮。將開關做成毛球的樣子，為三段式開關，可控制閃燈頻率。
works.english:
Ⅰ.Create a chandelier by extending the curve from U to W, twisting it, and adding small wool balls in two color options.

Ⅱ.Design small lamp sets with magnetic bases and wool ball switches to attach metal walls as wall lamps.
works.english_detail:
The design transitions from a U-shaped to a W-shape, enhancing layering through staggered twists. Available in two color options, its sleek suspension features hidden wires.

 The grid elements and hollow center create visual focus, while a playful fur ball switch controls the flashing frequency.
